data.gender_notes: Dhinesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhinesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Dhanvantari, who is considered the god of wealth and healing. The name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in all aspects of life. The name Dhinesh carries the meaning “God of riches” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhinesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of riches and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhinesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
